description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Kahengama, Kuruvita D/S Division, Ratnapura District (25/0234)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, their ownership details, extents, and legal status. The content focuses entirely on land registration matters, property ownership determinations, and cadastral information, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
